hero.name: Marco Linardi
hero.intro: A Computer Science & Mathematics student and full-stack developer based in Jakarta. I build things end to end — from AI-powered desktop apps to real-time multiplayer backends and microservice platforms — and care about clean architecture, secure auth, and code that holds up in production.

about.title: About
about.description: I'm a Computer Science & Mathematics scholarship student at Bina Nusantara University (GPA 3.73) who builds reliable software across the stack. My projects span AI desktop apps, real-time multiplayer systems, financial tooling, and microservice platforms — from clean, accessible interfaces to well-structured APIs, secure onboarding flows, and containerized services. I care about maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and shipping features that actually run in production.

items.title: Laboratory Assistant
items.body: Assist in teaching lab-based courses at BINUS University — delivering lectures and hands-on sessions, authoring exam and practice cases, and guiding students through real-world project work.

items.title: ICPC 2025
items.body: Competed in the International Collegiate Programming Contest, solving algorithmic problems under time pressure against university teams worldwide.

items.title: MonoClip
items.description: A free, offline-capable AI desktop video editor built with Tauri, React, Rust, and Python. It runs Whisper transcription, OPUS-MT caption translation, and rembg background removal fully on-device, with native FFmpeg processing and Google/GitHub OAuth. Built as a PKM-KC 2026 team submission.

items.title: FifteenPadel
items.description: A padel-court booking platform built as a NestJS + Next.js 16 monorepo backed by Postgres, Prisma, and Redis. Its standout feature is a Redis-backed email-OTP registration flow that defers user persistence until the code is confirmed, so abandoned signups never leave orphaned records.

items.title: Twitter Clone
items.description: A Twitter-style social platform where authenticated users post threads to a shared feed. Built on a Go gRPC microservices backend — an API gateway fronting independent auth and user services bound by shared Protocol Buffers contracts — with a Svelte 5 + Vite frontend over a MySQL data layer.

items.title: Mygamatotor
items.description: A real-time multiplayer game platform with a NestJS + Socket.IO backend and JWT-authenticated game rooms. It secures both the REST and WebSocket layers — including custom socket-handshake authentication — inside an npm-workspaces monorepo with Prisma-backed persistence and shared types.

items.title: MrTyper
items.description: A typing-speed practice and testing app pairing a Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript SPA with an ASP.NET (C#) backend API — a full-stack project spanning the JavaScript and .NET ecosystems, styled with Tailwind CSS.

items.title: Epic Math Saga
items.description: A cross-platform Kotlin/libGDX mobile game with a math-battle theme. A shared, platform-agnostic game core — tile-based battle and home maps, warrior/building entities, and stage managers — is decoupled from Android via a platform-adapter seam, with Firebase Auth and Cloud Firestore backing accounts and cloud data through an MVVM layer.
